channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Oct 07
item.description:
71 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Fixed incorrect shot settings that were causing weapons to fire with wrong parameters.
  • Restored the wounded first‑person sound and reduced its volume by 50% to address it being overly loud.
  • Fixed horse hip movement regression that prevented horses from sleeping and corrected dismounted horses keeping abnormal head/hip positions.
  • Fixed a rare crash when using the admin injure command, preventing server errors on player death.

Combat & Weapons

  • Fixed incorrect shot settings that were causing weapons to fire with wrong parameters.

Audio

  • Restored the wounded first‑person sound and reduced its volume by 50% to address it being overly loud.
  • Fixed harbor bridge and crane sounds playing on initial load.

Mounts & Vehicles

  • Fixed horse hip movement regression that prevented horses from sleeping and corrected dismounted horses keeping abnormal head/hip positions.

Explosives

  • Increased grenade throw velocity, making grenades travel farther.

Stability

  • Fixed crash related to ore flare (Flare fix test 2).

UI

  • Fixed screen blur issue on RC computer interface.

Stability & Compatibility

  • Fixed a rare crash when using the admin injure command, preventing server errors on player death.
  • Resolved crashes during map transitions by skipping unnecessary deinitialization when unloading scenes.
  • Added missing gamepad configuration files, restoring full gamepad support.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 06
item.description:
115 development commits

World & Navigation

  • Map icons for Tool Cupboards added and deep‑sea marker issues fixed, improving map clarity and preventing marker loss.
  • Ferry terminal rope ladder climbing fixed, eliminating climb glitches and stuck rung animations.

Combat & AI

  • Hit detection improved and boars now flee only below 30 % health, making combat more reliable and boar encounters less premature.
  • Livestock movement and feeding behavior refined, preventing cows from clipping and improving eating at troughs and grass.

Crafting & Items

  • New tea mixing‑table recipes and Wool Armor introduced, expanding crafting options and providing Tier 1 protection.
  • Crafting action moved to D‑pad down on all controller layouts for easier access.

Audio & Sound

  • BBQ and flame turret sounds corrected and one‑shot spawn noises (furnaces, campfires, mixing tables) silenced for a cleaner audio experience.

Player Impact

  • Fixed horses being able to fly, preventing unintended movement exploits.
  • Boombox mission events now only trigger for teammates on the same mission, avoiding irrelevant alerts.
  • Resolved client crashes caused by late-arriving network snapshots, improving stability during map transitions.
  • Tattoos now correctly persist between client and server, ensuring player cosmetics are saved.
  • Reloading maps now correctly includes level size data, preventing loading confusion when switching between maps.
  • Fixed several character customization bugs: UI fading issue, unwanted underwear prompt, and teleporting back to start when opening the menu.
  • Bee grenade prediction no longer shows a white grenade model, fixing visual glitch during throw prediction.
  • Fixed a NaN vertex lighting issue that could crash the game.
  • Helicopter flares now save correctly without corrupting job handlers, restoring flare functionality after saving.
  • Made helicopter flare saving thread‑safe, preventing crashes when multiple flares are saved simultaneously.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 05
item.description:
84 development commits

World & Locations

  • Fixed broken S2P apartments, bandit bases, and fishing villages so they now spawn correctly.

UI & Localization

  • Item drop and pickup notices now display correctly for right‑to‑left languages.
  • Crafting notices are now rendered with RustText, fixing RTL language display and eliminating per‑frame allocation spikes.

Gameplay & Mechanics

  • Softcore servers now enforce a maximum of three Tool Cupboards per base, with UI icons and toast notifications when the limit is reached.

Combat & Projectiles

  • Fixed a bug where projectiles could leak and persist after the owning player was destroyed.

Power & Generators

  • Biofuel generators now only consume electricity while actively generating fuel, reducing idle power drain.

Livestock

  • Fixed livestock age regression and variance errors, ensuring calves correctly age into adults and maintain accurate ages.
  • Increased the lead rope break distance from 7 m to 15 m and now display livestock familiarity and gender by default.
  • Raised the sale penalty for selling bought or found animals to the livestock vendor from 0.2 to 0.85, making it harder to profit from such sales.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Fixed motorcycle dismount order issue, ensuring players dismount safely and predictably.
  • Corrected client-side sailing wind calculations, improving sail handling and navigation accuracy.

Character Customisation

  • Introduced a revamped character creator layout for easier navigation of customization options.
  • Added an underwear customization category, expanding player outfit choices.
  • Removed the eyebrows category, streamlining available facial features.
